parameters.description: Specifies a pointer to a DWORD location used to return the current pitch multiplier value. This is specified as a fixed-point value, where the high-order WORD of the DWORD contains the signed integer part of the number and the low-order WORD contains the fractional part. The fraction consists of a WORD value, for which 0x8000 represents one-half and 0x4000 represents one-fourth. For example, the value 0x00010000 specifies a multiplier of 1.0, with no pitch change, and a value of 0x000F8000 specifies a multiplier of 15.5.
